description.value:
Some who walk the Beastmaster Approach don't channel nature within themselves — they forge a bond with it, calling a beast companion to stand at their side. The bond deepens as the berserker's fury grows, until master and creature move and strike as one.

In battle, this pair hunts together: the berserker's rage empowers the beast, and the beast's ferocity feeds back into the berserker's own resolve.
